text: {"label":"Low-Cost Custom Laboratory Apparatus Design","definition":"Work on building affordable custom equipment for operant research, such as relay and timer circuits, microcontroller-based chambers and novel experimental instruments, plus a few conceptual papers about stimulus–response circuits.","distinct_from_neighbours":"It covers building whole devices and circuits, not data-recording methods and computer interfacing, shock or drug-delivery apparatus for animals, or applied programming and instruction."}
